seoTitle: 🍐 Pear Emoji Meaning - What Does 🍐 Really Mean?
seoDescription: Learn what the pear emoji 🍐 really means in texts and social media.

longForm.overview:
The 🍐 Pear emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as a yellow-green pear with a small stem and leaf. The visual cue reads instantly as pear, fruit-coded default, or the visible-'butt' coded alternate. By 2026 🍐 has become the go-to emoji for the pear-coded fruit reaction, the visible-fruit default, and the butt-coded alternate read.

In modern chat 🍐 does very specific work. People send it as a literal pear reference, as the visible fruit default, or as the butt-coded alternate. The pear-shape is the visual cue that the read is fruit-coded (with a secondary butt-coded layer). Writers should pick 🍐 when the read is fruit or butt-coded alternate, and avoid it when the read is flirty-pair — 🍒 fits better there.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
🍐 lands on a friend's 'snack time' message, in a work channel where someone is signing off with food-coded content, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is sending fruit-coded content. The pear-shape anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 🍐 reads as the universal pear-coded fruit default. On X the emoji punctuates snack-coded and butt-coded alternate tweets. The emoji pairs with 🍎 for the layered fruit pair stack and with 🍌 for the layered yellow-fruit pair stack.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 🍐 in any context where the read is flirty-pair-coded — 🍒 fits better. Avoid 🍐 in work channels where the butt-coded alternate read lands as off-task. Pick 🍎 when the read is fruit-coded and a different shape is needed.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 🍐 on a fruit-coded message, mirror with another 🍐 or 🍎 to match the fruit-coded energy. The pear chain reads as solidarity.

If 🍐 lands as the butt-coded alternate default, reply with a sentence that engages the read. And if you want to send 🍐 yourself, pair it with the moment so the fruit-coded read is clear.

faqs.question: What does 🍐 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 🍐 means pear, fruit-coded default, or butt-coded alternate. The pear-shape is the visual cue that the read is fruit-coded (with a secondary butt-coded layer).

faqs.question: Is 🍐 flirty?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, gently. 🍐 reads as butt-coded alternate when paired with body-coded content. By itself it is more fruit-coded than flirty-coded.

faqs.question: What does 🍐 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: From a guy or anyone, 🍐 carries the same fruit-coded read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 🍐 mean on Instagram?
faqs.answer: On Instagram, 🍐 is the default sticker on fruit-aesthetic-coded captions and butt-coded alternate story overlays.
